method: The 42 records below group the 89 audited units (24 FAQ answers, 25 body sections, 36 component strings, 4 seoDescriptions). A corrected record can carry several changed sentences; corrections counts the 29 changed passages. Decisions are per record.

statements.sentence: jq 1.7.1 itself via jq-web 0.6.2; 71 filters byte for byte; 239 manual examples that do not read environment variables.

statements.sentence: Filter, options, variables and editor input up to 40 KB are saved; 50 KB serialized limit; Clear removes saved input and keeps the filter.
statements.qualification: persist() saves filter/opts/args and input only when state.file is null and length <= 40*1024; ztPersist rejects JSON over 50*1024; Clear calls clear() then persist().

statements.sentence: Files up to 200 MB; over 2 MB press Run; panel shows 1 MB; run stopped after 10 s plus 1 s per MB.
statements.qualification: Constants match 2 MiB / 200 MiB / 1 MiB. The stop budget uses input.length (UTF-16 code units, 1e6 per second), so 'per MB' is generous for non-ASCII input; wording kept consistent with the tested tooltip.
